text: The task checks four fields before copying and five fields after copying with Assert.equal calls that have no message argument. This includes the copied reference count and first Message-ID checks. They are existing missing diagnostics in the inspected task; the context-menu target/wait change does not introduce them or demonstrate a test failure.
title: The copy-from-file task retains nine scalar assertions without messages
